Thưởng tháng 13, Thưởng hiệu quả làm việc
description:
* Build AI Agents for Real Work: Start with one or two core agents, then expand into agents for everyday business roles, such as a media buying assistant, a content creation agent, sales follow-ups, simple finance tasks, or a chief-of-staff agent that manages email, calendar and messages. You'll also help choose the tools and models we build on.
* Connect the Tools People Use: Integrate agents with Gmail, Google Calendar, Zalo, Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram and similar tools through APIs and automation platforms.
* Keep Them Simple and Reliable: Make every agent easy for non-technical people to set up and use, and keep it working as models and tools change.
* Support the Users (around 20% of your time): Write clear setup guides and join live workshops to help learners get their agents running.
requirements_text:
* 3+ Years Hands-On Experience: A proven track record building automations, AI agents or LLM-based workflows that real people use.
* Real Tool Experience: Strong with at least one of Claude (Projects, Skills, MCP), OpenAI APIs, n8n, Make.com or similar, and good at making agents produce reliable, consistent results.
* API and Integration Skills: Comfortable connecting tools through APIs and webhooks.
* Code: Solid Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. No-code tools alone won't be enough for this role.
* Memory, Evaluation and Deployment (basic level): You've stored user data and conversation memory, set up simple RAG, tested agents so they give reliable output, and deployed tools like n8n or OpenClaw on a server.
* Language: Fluent in Vietnamese. Basic English is enough for reading documentation and simple written communication.
